kyoto_muromachi_yui.gf_detail: Ask. A single omakase kaiseki course with dashi-based soups, sushi, tempura and grilled dishes; no gluten information (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_muromachi_yui.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kaiseki of fish, shellfish, crab and dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_muromachi_yui.hours_raw: 17:00–20:30 (last entry); closed Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). Reservation only, by the day before; by phone or web (official site; Tabelog). One omakase course (Tabelog shop text), ¥30,000 at a first visit (July 2025; August 2026). 10 seats at a curved counter looking onto a garden; the room can be hired for up to 20; designated smoking area (Tabelog; February 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). In a townhouse on Oshikoji-dori west of Karasuma; 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 2 (Tabelog). Opened 15 December 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_muromachi_yui.notes: [Kaiseki · Karasuma Oike, 前田一光's counter by a garden] A 10-seat curved counter in a townhouse on quiet Oshikoji, facing a garden, where 前田一光 — born in Gifu to a restaurant family — serves one omakase kaiseki a night (about ¥30,000) built from that morning's market and Tango fish: playful dishes like corn-wrapped prawn tempura, then clay-pot rice with nine or ten side dishes to graze. Reviewers describe it as holding two Michelin stars. Book by the day before; last entry 20:30; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 前田一光 (MAEDA KAZUTERU) was born in Nakatsugawa, Gifu, and grew up in the kitchen of the restaurant run by a parent ("料理屋を営む父親のもと"); after high school, trained in Kyoto aiming to equal that father; became owner of 室町 唯 in December 2019. The site describes visits to the market every morning, daily contact with Tango fishing ports, a counter built so guests watch the cooking, and a garden view. Reviewers in June–August 2026 say the restaurant holds two Michelin stars; a June 2026 reviewer describes a head chef and a wine-loving owner who joined guests for a drink, and says regulars sometimes bring their own wine.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "唯一無二の食事を目指して" — food that can only be had here; nothing used that the kitchen is not satisfied with; menus not bound by convention.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase kaiseki; clay-pot rice with many side dishes.

anecdotes.text: "What stood out the most was the variety of about 9 different accompaniments for the rice, all available for unlimited servings." — February 2026.
"I was lucky that there was a large supply of tuna caught by a customer, so we could have unlimited servings of tuna rice bowl." — June 2026.
"They wrapped the shrimp in the corn after steaming and cooling it, then tempura-fried it, which created an interesting texture." — August 2026.
"The chef is from Gifu, so we enjoyed Hoba Sushi and plenty of hairy crab." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (muromachi-yui.jp): 京都烏丸御池の会席料理店、17:00〜20:30 (最終入店)、水曜定休、完全予約制、唯一無二の食事を目指して、市場に毎朝通い最高の食材だけを仕入れ、丹後の漁港と毎朝連絡、既成概念に捉われない献立、カウンター中心の内装と庭、季節に合わせた煎茶、ビンテージも含む日本酒、店主 前田一光 (MAEDA KAZUTERU): 岐阜県中津川市生まれ、料理屋を営む父親のもと幼少期から調理場に入る、高校卒業後に京都で修行、2019年12月に室町 唯の店主に就任。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理、中京区押小路通烏丸西入金吹町459、烏丸御池駅2番出口から徒歩3分、完全予約制 (前日まで)、おまかせコースのみ、10席 (カウンター)、貸切20名まで、カード可、2019年12月15日オープン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年9月、英語): コース30,000円、ミシュラン二つ星、ご飯のお供9〜10種、朴葉寿司、毛蟹、とうもろこしで巻いた海老の天ぷら、庭の見える曲線のカウンター。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by the day before; one omakase course at a counter; cards accepted.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing (staff-maintained); reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_kentan_horibe.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki of dashi-based soups, mackerel sushi, sashimi with soy-based dips, grilled and fried fish, simmered beef and rice with tsukudani; no gluten information (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kentan_horibe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses are built on fish, soft-shelled turtle, Omi beef and dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kentan_horibe.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–12:30 last entry, closes 14:00; dinner 18:00–19:30 last entry, closes 22:00; closed Tuesday; reservation required (official site; Tabelog gives slightly different last entries). Phone bookings 14:00–17:00, or TableCheck; changes or cancellations by phone at least three days ahead; cancellation fees 25% two days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day (official site). Even when Tabelog shows full, seats may be free by phone or the website (Tabelog). Dress code: no sweatpants, jeans, shorts or sandals; cover tattoos; no strong perfume (Tabelog). Children below elementary school age only in private rooms (Tabelog). 14 seats at a counter and tables, plus private rooms for 4–6 with a room charge of 10–20% of the food (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). In a townhouse on Nishikikoji west of Muromachi; 4 min walk from Shijo Stn / Karasuma Stn exits 22 and 24 (official site). Opened here 10 December 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kentan_horibe.notes: [Kaiseki · Shijo Karasuma, 堀部努's Kyoto cuisine] A townhouse kaiseki restaurant on Nishikikoji with a small garden, a counter and private rooms, where 堀部努 — who cooked in Gion, at Gion Horibe, before moving here — serves monthly Kyoto courses: soft-shelled turtle soup, sea bream from Akashi, fried hamo with figs, a hassun in a basket. Lunch ¥12,000, dinner ¥25,000, tax and service included; Tabelog also sells pricier "courses for foreign guests". Michelin one star nine years running, per its site. Dress smartly; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 研覃 (けんたん) means to pursue and explore deeply and to cultivate oneself; the owner signs as 店主 堀部 努; site news marks a Michelin one star for nine years running (July 2026) and the restaurant’s twentieth anniversary (August 2026). A September 2026 reviewer names the chef as Tsutomu Horibe, who honed skills in Gion and at "Gion Horibe" before moving to Karasuma; Tabelog dates this site from 10 December 2016. A November 2025 regular notes foreign guests at lunch; a July 2026 reviewer says the owner-chef and staff always seem to enjoy their work.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to serve the world through cooking for the guest’s "delicious!", and to grow as people.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki; hassun; soft-shelled turtle soup.

anecdotes.text: "Upon entering, the owner personally greeted us, and there was a natural warmth in the way the dishes were presented." — November 2025.
"I asked about it, and they told me they grind the conger twice—a truly labor-intensive dish." — of the hamo surinagashi, August 2026.
"The owner-chef and the staff always seemed to be enjoying their work, which left a lasting impression." — July 2026.
A November 2025 group of five paid ¥12,000 each for lunch plus a 5% private-room fee and found the hospitality worth it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-horibe.com): 研覃 (けんたん) とは「深ク深ク追求スル、探求スル。又自分自身ヲ耕シ研鑽スル」という意、店主 堀部 努、昼餉12,000円・夕餉25,000円 (税・サ込)、昼11時30分〜12時30分 (最終入店) 14時閉店、夜18時00分〜19時30分 (最終入店) 22時閉店、火曜定休、電話予約は14時〜17時、TableCheck、キャンセル料 (2日前25%、前日50%、当日100%)、一つ星9年連続 (2026年7月)、二十周年 (2026年8月)、おせち、四条駅・烏丸駅22番・24番出口から徒歩4分。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理・海鮮・創作、中京区錦小路通室町西入ル天神山町273、外国人のお客様限定コース 昼15,000円 (現金のみ)・夜28,000円、ドレスコード、タトゥーは隠す、未就学児は個室のみ、14席、個室あり (個室料10〜20%)、カード可、2016年12月10日オープン、店舗紹介: 京都の五味・五色・五法、町家と坪庭。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 祇園時代からの名店、すっぽんと玉子豆腐の椀、Akashi の鯛、鱧の揚げ物と Joyo のいちじく、Omi beef、Tango のお米、八寸、杉板焼き。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (phone 14:00–17:00 or TableCheck); smart dress; Tabelog sells separate, pricier courses for foreign guests.

existence.note: Official site (2026 news) and Tabelog listing (staff-maintained); reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_itameshi_oliva.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, risotto, gratin with bread and fried olives stuffed with meat dominate; carpaccio, prosciutto and roasts are also served; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_itameshi_oliva.vegan_detail: Ask. Most dishes use seafood, meat or cheese; seasonal vegetable and fruit appetizers appear, but no vegan dish is named (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_itameshi_oliva.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Friday–Sunday 17:00–24:00; Thursday 19:00–24:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations by phone (Tabelog) or Instagram DM (June 2026); a ¥1,000 per-person fee for same-day no-shows; at least one food item and one drink each; a 120-minute limit when busy (Tabelog). 12 seats: a 5-seat counter and small tables (Tabelog). Prices shown before tax; no charge (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Third floor of the 先斗町たばこやビル: from Pontocho, take alley no. 15 on the north side and the lift to 3F (Tabelog). 3 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 2 August 2017 (Tabelog).
kyoto_itameshi_oliva.notes: [Italian · Pontocho, a third-floor hideaway with Wakasa produce] A twelve-seat Italian up a lift in the Tabakoya building, reached from Pontocho's alley no. 15. The owner-chef is from Obama in Fukui and builds the menu around Wakasa fish, seasonal produce and Wakasa rice: start with the antipasto platter or prosciutto and mozzarella, then the squid-ink risotto, a seasonal pasta, oyster gratin or the lamb steak, and panna cotta. Portions are generous and good for sharing; the owner will cook off-menu on request. About ¥14,000 for two with wine (July 2025). Book by phone; closed Wednesday, open to midnight.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed; November 2024 reviews: "The owner is from Obama in Fukui", "The owner-chef is friendly")
chef_bio.origin: Obama, Fukui Prefecture (November 2024 and February 2025 reviews).
chef_bio.background: Tabelog's introduction describes fresh seafood and seasonal ingredients from Wakasa in Obama City, Fukui Prefecture, and risotto of Wakasa rice. Tabelog gives the opening as 2 August 2017.
chef_bio.specialty: Squid-ink risotto; seasonal pasta; fried stuffed olives.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 diner found the owner running the room alone because the staff member was off sick, with four groups in.
A November 2024 regular named the squid-ink risotto "a flavor bomb" and the meat-stuffed fried olives a perfect match for Italian beer.
A May 2025 reviewer notes the place is popular with foreign tourists, so phone booking is essential, and that the owner will make dishes not on the menu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタメシOliva、イタリアン・バル・居酒屋、中京区下樵木町202-4-1 先斗町たばこやビル 3F、河原町駅から徒歩約3分、月火金土日 17:00〜24:00、木 19:00〜24:00、水曜休み、電話予約、当日の無断キャンセルは1人1,000円、1人1品1ドリンク以上、混雑時120分制、12席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、英語メニュー、税別表記、2017年8月2日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): Fukui の Obama の Wakasa の鮮魚と旬の食材、Wakasa の米のリゾット、先斗町の15番路地。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 店主は Obama 出身、ペペロンチーノ、イカスミのリゾット、オリーブの肉詰めフライ、牡蠣のグラタン、ラムステーキ、パンナコッタ、2人でワイン1本と約14,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); popular with visitors from abroad; book by phone or Instagram DM.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through June 2026.

kyoto_men_kui_kin_ya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: handmade wheat udon and battered tempura and kushikatsu (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_men_kui_kin_ya.vegan_detail: Ask. A February 2025 reviewer says the shop offers vegan options and English menus, but the standard broth is bonito and kombu dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_men_kui_kin_ya.hours_raw: Tabelog: Monday–Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday 11:30–15:40 and 18:00–19:40; closed Thursday and Friday. An October 2025 review instead gives 11:30–20:00 (last order 19:30), closed Monday (or the next day after a holiday). No reservations; queues at times (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). 15 seats (7 counter, two tables for 4); non-smoking (Tabelog). No cards; e-money and QR payments accepted (Tabelog). On a corner of the Miyagawacho tea-house streets, marked by a large lantern; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; April 2026).
kyoto_men_kui_kin_ya.notes: [Udon · Miyagawacho, handmade flat udon by the tea houses] A small handmade-udon counter on a corner of Miyagawacho's tea-house streets, under a big lantern, five minutes from Gion-Shijo Stn. The owner makes the noodles: thin, flat and glossy, from Kyoto wheat, boiled to order and served in a clear bonito-and-kombu broth. Kake udon from ¥650; the Kujo negi tempura with cold udon (¥1,300) and the tempura bowls are the popular orders. Reviews split on the tempura — some find it light and crisp, an August 2026 diner found it greasy — but agree on the noodles. Many guests are visitors from abroad; English menu. Hours vary between sources; check before going.

roles: Owner, who researches and makes the noodles by hand (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog's introduction: the owner researches and makes the noodles by hand; tempura and kushikatsu are specialities; the shop sits in Miyagawacho among tea houses. An April 2025 reviewer saw the udon being made, to the delight of tourists.
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade flat udon; Kujo negi tempura.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 reviewer noted that 70–80% of the customers were from abroad and that the shop offers English menus and vegan options.
An August 2026 diner praised the flat Kyoto-wheat udon but found the tempura greasy and the chicken tough: "Just come for the udon."
An August 2026 visitor liked the burdock and onion tempura (¥180 each) so much with a little salt that it never went into the udon.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 麺喰金家、うどん、東山区博多町112-2、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月火水土日 11:30〜15:40・18:00〜19:40、木金休み、予約不可、15席 (カウンター7、4人テーブル2)、禁煙、カード不可、電子マネー・QR 可。店の紹介 (英訳): 店主が研究を重ねた手打ちの麺、天ぷらと串カツ、宮川町のお茶屋の並ぶ通り。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 京都の小麦の平打ち麺、かつおと昆布の澄んだ出汁、かけうどん650円、たぬきうどん1,150円、九条ねぎの天ぷらと冷やしうどんのセット1,300円、天丼、卵かけご飯、英語メニュー、ヴィーガン対応、海外からの客が多い、2025年10月の口コミでは11:30〜20:00 (L.O. 19:30)・月曜休み。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (February 2025); most guests are from abroad; no cards, but e-money and QR payments.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_cafe_de_corazon.gf_detail: Ask. House-made tarts, cheesecake, cookies, parfaits, French toast and toast; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_de_corazon.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee suits, but the sweets use cream, cheese and eggs (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_de_corazon.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and the third Monday (Tabelog). No seat reservations, but cakes can be held (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog: payment changed to cash only; September 2026). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; one parking space (Tabelog; October 2026). Takeaway: coffee beans, baked goods, coffee jelly (Tabelog; September 2026). 8–9 min walk from Imadegawa Stn (2026 reviews). Opened 12 June 2012 (Tabelog).
kyoto_cafe_de_corazon.notes: [Café · Nishijin, an eight-seat roastery counter] A counter café in a residential lane of Nishijin, opened in 2012 by Katsushi Kawaguchi, who trained and served as manager at the famed Cafe Bach in Tokyo's Minami-Senju, with the owner's wife, a pastry chef. About 20 house-roasted, hand-sorted beans are brewed to order; cakes, tarts and seasonal parfaits come from the wife's oven; seasonal paintings change on the walls. Coffee from about ¥930 (October 2026), cheesecake ¥450. Eight seats, no seat bookings, cash only. Closed Sunday and the third Monday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Katsushi Kawaguchi (romaji from a September 2026 review; the kanji is not in a source)
roles: Owner and roaster (September 2026 review: "The owner, Katsushi Kawaguchi, trained at ... Cafe Bach")
The owner's wife, a pastry chef, makes the sweets (September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per September 2026 reviews: the owner trained at Cafe Bach in Minami-Senju, Tokyo, and served as its manager; the owner's wife, originally from Kyoto and a pastry chef, makes the sweets; the café roasts on the same type of roaster as Cafe Bach. One September 2026 reviewer gives the founding of this shop as 2002; Tabelog gives the opening as 12 June 2012. An August 2026 reviewer mentions a second shop, cafe de corazon Nino, in Nijo. Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Hand-sorted house-roasted coffee; seasonal tarts and parfaits.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular (22 visits) noted the seasonal paintings on the walls — a Gion Matsuri float earlier, chrysanthemums for the Chōyō festival in September.
A September 2026 visitor bought the coffee jelly to take away; it separated before reaching the hotel but still tasted delicious.
An October 2026 diner found coffee from ¥930 a bit pricey but enjoyed it from a Wedgwood mug and a long chat with the owner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ デ コラソン (cafe de corazon)、カフェ、上京区革堂町593-15、今出川駅から604m、月〜土 10:00〜17:00、日曜と第3月曜休み、席の予約不可 (ケーキの取り置きは可)、現金のみに変更、カウンター8席、禁煙、駐車場1台、テイクアウト可、2012年6月12日オープン、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。公式サイト (cafe-de-corazon.com): 自家焙煎珈琲と手作りお菓子のお店、コーヒー豆とお菓子のオンラインショップ。口コミ (2026年、英語): 店主 Katsushi Kawaguchi は Minami-Senju の Cafe Bach で修業し店長も務めた、パティシエの奥さん、約20種の豆、ハンドピック、チーズケーキ450円、季節のタルトとパフェ、コーヒー930円から、二条に2号店 Nino。

cultural_comfort.note: Eight counter seats; cash only; cakes can be held by phone.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and the shop's online store; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_songbird_coffee.gf_detail: Ask. The signature curry comes with rice, fried onions and a soft-boiled egg, while the egg sandwiches use buttered bread; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_songbird_coffee.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature dishes are built on egg (the thick omelette sandwich, the curry's soft-boiled egg), with butter, cheese and chicken (2026 reviews).
kyoto_songbird_coffee.hours_raw: 10:00–18:30, last order 18:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; a wait at lunch (October 2026). 25 seats: a counter of single boxes, tables for 2, 4 and 6; non-smoking; children and prams welcome (Tabelog; October, November 2026). Cards, IC cards and QR payments (Tabelog). Egg sandwiches to take away (October 2026). Second floor of SONGBIRD DESIGN STORE, near Nijo Castle; 7–8 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 16 May 2009 (Tabelog).
kyoto_songbird_coffee.notes: [Café · Nijo Castle, curry and egg sandwiches above a design store] A café on the second floor of SONGBIRD DESIGN STORE near Nijo Castle, furnished with the studio's own furniture and goods (some for sale). The two dishes everyone orders are the SONGBIRD curry — a cylinder of rice crowned with a soft-boiled egg and crisp onions — and the hot, thick egg sandwich on buttered bread; the half-and-half lunch (¥1,650) gets both. Coffee comes from roasters around Japan; the hojicha banana shake is a big glass. Expect a short queue at lunch. Open 10:00–18:30, closed Thursday.

roles: Run with SONGBIRD DESIGN STORE, a Kyoto interior and furniture studio (Tabelog address; October 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: An October 2026 reviewer describes the café as designed by an interior designer and furnished with original furniture and décor; another notes that the company also runs a furniture store and sells some of the café's items. Tabelog gives the opening as 16 May 2009. Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner rated the egg sandwich as good as the one at Yamamoto Kissa and bought a coaster and a sticker in the shop.
A November 2026 visitor sat in a single-person box at the counter and had an iced coffee from "Café Vivant Dimanche" of Kamakura (¥850), too big to finish, so half went into a takeaway cup.
An October 2026 regular compares the egg sandwich with those of "Maduragu" and "Tirol".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: SONGBIRD COFFEE、カフェ・カレー、中京区竹屋町通堀川東入西竹屋町529 SONGBIRD DESIGN STORE. 2F、二条城前駅から516m、10:00〜18:30 (L.O. 18:00)、木曜休み、予約不可、25席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、テイクアウト可、子ども・ベビーカー歓迎、2009年5月16日オープン、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年、英語): インテリアデザイナーが手がけた店、家具店も運営、SONGBIRD カレー (筒形のご飯に半熟卵とフライドオニオン)、厚焼き卵のたまごサンド1,350円、ハーフ&ハーフランチ1,650円、全国のロースターのコーヒー、ほうじ茶バナナシェイク900円、バター羊羹、チーズケーキ。

cultural_comfort.note: No reservations; cards and QR payments.

kyoto_nishiki_katsuzushi.gf_detail: Ask. Temari sushi with sauces and condiments, inari, tempura and red miso soup; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_nishiki_katsuzushi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the sets are fish temari sushi with tempura and miso soup; a few pieces (lotus root, yuba, inari) are plant-based but come in mixed sets (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nishiki_katsuzushi.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 (last order 15:00) and 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:00), every day (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). 20 seats: 16 at the counter facing the kitchen, one table for four; non-smoking; English menu; cards only, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Just off the Nishiki Market arcade; near Kyoto Kawaramachi and Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; April 2026).
kyoto_nishiki_katsuzushi.notes: [Temari sushi · Nishiki Market] A bright counter just off the Nishiki Market arcade, opened in 2025, serving temari sushi — small round pieces said to have been made for maiko — in sets of twelve with tempura or obanzai and miso soup (lunch about ¥3,600). Pretty and photogenic; reviewers split between delighted and underwhelmed by the taste and service. Open daily; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 January 2025 (Tabelog). Per the operator’s Tabelog text: a pioneer of the temari-sushi trend, with seafood from Nishiki Market and an original sake.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner was surprised to find mostly Japanese customers rather than tourists, and noted the format may have changed recently.
A March 2026 evening diner found more than half the guests from overseas, the portions small, the taste unremarkable at over ¥3,000, and the staff unfriendly.
A May 2026 reviewer could not hear the softly spoken staff and noted dust on the counter bottles.
A family of four generations was completely satisfied — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 錦 活鮨、寿司・日本料理・天ぷら、中京区高宮町594-2、毎日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:00)、予約可、20席 (カウンター16、4人掛けテーブル1)、禁煙、英語メニュー、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、2025年1月23日オープン、錦市場の魚介の手まり寿司、地酒約30種とオリジナルの日本酒。口コミ (2026年3〜8月、英語): 手まり寿司12貫、おばんざい・天ぷら・刺身の3種、赤だし、抹茶パフェ、寿司ランチ3,600円、12種の薬味、評価は分かれる。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); counter seats; cards only.

kyoto_dor_gion.gf_detail: Ask. French à la carte plus galettes and crêpes, canelés and spring rolls; no gluten information, and the galette flour is not described (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_dor_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: charcuterie, duck, venison and lobster dishes, and crêpes with butter and cream (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_dor_gion.hours_raw: 14:00–23:00 every day; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Bookings via TableCheck (September 2026); also used as a café for crêpes and galettes (May 2026). 8 counter seats facing a crêpe station, plus table seats upstairs by reservation; designated smoking area; cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). In an alley south of Shijo near Dango-bashi, toward Miyagawa-cho; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_dor_gion.notes: [French & crêpes · south of Shijo near Dango-bashi] A small French counter in a Gion back alley, opened in 2021, where a pastry-trained chef cooks bistro plates — charcuterie, duck ham, venison — and then makes crêpes and galettes at a station in front of you: lemon-butter-white-pepper citron, Calpis-butter sugar, seasonal fruit. Champagne by the glass; also good just for crêpes. Open 14:00–23:00; book on TableCheck.

roles: Chef ("Chef Sakane" in an August 2026 review); pastry background (August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 19 May 2021 (Tabelog). Per 2026 reviews: the chef comes from pastry, so the desserts are a strength, and a crêpe station sits at the counter.

anecdotes.text: A five-time visitor’s favourite is the crêpe with Calpis fermented butter and sugar — August 2026.
A December 2025 family birthday ended with canelés, a bear-shaped monaka and a strawberry crêpe, then a second, citron crêpe.
At the end of a March 2026 course the canelé was boxed to take home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: d'or、フレンチ、東山区博多町63-2、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日 14:00〜23:00、不定休、予約可、8席、2階にテーブル席 (要予約)、分煙、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、2021年5月19日オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年9月、英語): パティシエ出身のシェフ、カウンターのクレープ台、シャルキュトリー、鴨のハム、春巻き、鹿、ブルーチーズのガレット、カルピス発酵バターのクレープ、シトロンのクレープ、カヌレ、自家製キャラメルアイス、グラスのシャンパーニュ、TableCheck で予約。

cultural_comfort.note: Book on TableCheck; counter seats; drop in for crêpes in the afternoon.

kyoto_kameya_kiyonaga.gf_detail: Ask. The signature seijō kankidan is a rice- and wheat-flour dough fried in sesame oil (an October 2026 review), and the shop lists wheat flour among its main ingredients (official notice); other sweets are bean paste and chestnut, with no ingredient list published.
kyoto_kameya_kiyonaga.vegan_detail: Ask. Bean-paste and fried sweets such as the seijō kankidan may suit, but no ingredient list is published, and the dorayaki and kintsuba are not described (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kameya_kiyonaga.hours_raw: 8:30–17:00; closed Wednesday and some other days — in November 2026 also the 12th and 19th (Thursdays) (official site). Tabelog gives 8:30–17:30. Takeaway shop; orders by phone or the online shop for delivery (official site). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On the south side of the stone steps below Yasaka Shrine — face the west gate and turn right without crossing Higashioji-dori (official site); 460 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kameya_kiyonaga.notes: [Wagashi · Gion, a confectioner since 1617] A Kyoto sweets house founded in 1617, now facing Yasaka Shrine's west gate, that has supplied temples and shrines for centuries. Its signature, the seijō kankidan, is a Nara-period Tang sweet — a hard, pouch-shaped dough of rice and wheat flour around spiced bean paste, fried in sesame oil (¥750 each). Also kintsuba, chestnut sweets and seasonal fresh sweets. Closed Wednesday and some Thursdays.

roles: Operator: 亀屋清永 (company); no person named
chef_bio.background: Per the official history page: founded, by tradition, in 1617 (Genna 3), living at Teramachi-Sanjo with the trade name 亀屋冶兵衛 before taking the name 亀屋清永; listed in 1842 among the confectioners supplying the Imperial Palace; the seijō kankidan descends from the Tang confections brought by envoys in the Nara period and is called the root of Kyoto sweets. Tabelog Japanese-sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026. In October–November 2026 the shop sold its seijō kankidan and buto at the 78th Shōsōin exhibition in Nara (official site).

anecdotes.text: Plaques inside show supply to Chion-in, Yasaka Shrine, Enryaku-ji and Nanzen-ji — October 2026.
The staff suggested a freshly made dorayaki alongside the kankidan — October 2026.
At 16:00 on a Saturday the choice of fresh sweets was limited — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kameyakiyonaga.co.jp): 京御菓子司 亀屋清永、創業は元和3年 (1617年) と伝わる、寺町三条北入に住み当時の屋号は亀屋冶兵衛、のちに亀屋清永、天保13年 (1842年) の御所巻物、清浄歓喜団は奈良時代に遣唐使が伝えた唐菓子で京菓子のルーツ、多くの寺社仏閣の御用達、本店は八坂神社西楼門の前 (東山区祇園石段下南)、8:30〜17:00、毎週水曜定休 (その他不定休、2026年11月は4・11・12・18・19・25日)、清浄歓喜団と餢飳、京きんつば「吟角」、栗くり、季節の和菓子、オンラインショップ、主原料は砂糖・小豆・小麦粉・ごま油 (2024年の価格改定のお知らせ)、第78回正倉院展での特別販売。食べログ: 和菓子、祇園石段下南側534、月火木〜日 8:30〜17:30、水曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): 清浄歓喜団1個750円・2個1,620円、吟角518円、栗くり205円、どら焼き、寺社の御用達の札。

cultural_comfort.note: Small shop counter; staff suggest sweets; cards accepted.

existence.note: Official site (October 2026 notice) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_tsuneya_densuke.gf_detail: Ask. Over a hundred à la carte dishes — sashimi, grilled fish, saba sushi, tempura, fried conger and whale, miso dengaku, bear hot pot; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsuneya_densuke.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the menu centres on seasonal fish, wagyu and bear, with dashi-based cooking (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsuneya_densuke.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 17:30–22:30; closed Sunday and twice more a month — in November 2026 the Thursdays and Sundays plus the 23rd (official site). Tabelog gives 17:00–22:30, closed Thursday and Sunday. Bookings by phone; popular, so book early (official site; September 2026). The menu shows no prices; bills about ¥10,000–20,000 a head (2026 reviews). No children under junior-high age (Tabelog). 14 seats: 5 at the counter, tables and one private room with a sunken kotatsu; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners only (Tabelog; April 2026). On the corner of Sakaimachi and Nijo; 7 min from Marutamachi or Karasuma Oike Stn (official site).
kyoto_tsuneya_densuke.notes: [Kappo izakaya · south of the Imperial Palace, a hundred dishes and bear hot pot] A small izakaya on a quiet corner near the palace, open about 25 years, with no set courses: pick from over a hundred seasonal dishes — a famous sashimi platter, shirokuji, thick saba sushi, hamo shabu, and its rare bear hot pot. No prices on the menu; expect ¥10,000–20,000 with sake. Book ahead. No children under junior-high age. Closed Sunday and some Thursdays.

roles: Owner (unnamed; the official site says the owner chooses the ingredients)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: in its 25th year, with the owner choosing seasonal fish and vegetables; all dishes à la carte, from traditional kappo to creative cooking; the website opened in June 2025. Tabelog Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "自分の好きなものを好きなだけ食べていただきたい" — eat what you like, as much as you like.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; bear hot pot; saba sushi.

anecdotes.text: Wanting sake, a July 2026 guest had the sashimi platter cut from ten kinds to five by the owner; the bill came to about ¥15,000 as expected.
After the sashimi, a fish-bone cracker and red miso soup from the bones arrived unasked — September 2026.
A September 2026 diner was nervous at the counter because the menu shows no prices.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tsuneyadensuke.com): 京都の本格割烹居酒屋 恒屋伝助、創業25年、店主が四季の魚介や野菜を厳選、コースではなく全て一品料理、百を超す逸品、白ぐじ焼、和牛炭火焼き、鯖寿司 (持ち帰りは前日までに予約)、熊鍋、造り盛り合わせ、中京区観音町84 堺町二条の角、丸太町駅・烏丸御池駅から徒歩約7分、月〜土 17:30〜22:30、日曜定休、月二回不定休、2026年11月の休み (1・5・8・12・15・19・23・26・29日)。食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・日本料理、月火水金土 17:00〜22:30、木・日休み、中学生未満入店不可、14席 (カウンター5、テーブル10)、個室、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2024。口コミ (2026年4〜9月、英語): 値段の書かれていないメニュー、刺身盛り合わせ、熊肉と花山椒、鱧しゃぶと松茸、鯨の唐揚げ、賀茂なすの田楽、鯖寿司。

cultural_comfort.note: No prices on the menu, so ask; book by phone; JCB, AMEX or Diners only.

kyoto_sushi_obino.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae sushi with soy-brushed nigiri, small dishes with miso and egg-yolk vinegar, and a soup; no gluten information is published (official site; 2022–26 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_obino.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses only (official site).
kyoto_sushi_obino.hours_raw: 17:00–21:00, last entry 19:30; closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog lists every day 17:00–21:00). Bookings via the web or by email; the courses no longer start all at once — come at any time (official site). Lunch teyui-zushi is described on the official site; no lunch hours are given. 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards; children welcome, with a children’s menu; tell the shop ahead about a stroller (Tabelog; official site). At the back of the 若葉ビル on the east side of Tomikoji north of Nishiki (south of Takoyakushi); 7 min from Shijo Stn, 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (official site). Opened 1 October 2020 (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_obino.notes: [Sushi · Tomikoji-Nishiki, counter sushi made approachable] An eight-seat Edomae counter at the back of a building on Tomikoji just north of Nishiki, opened in 2020 and reworked in 2023 to make counter sushi easier for younger and overseas guests: a ¥6,000 course by its young artisans, the head chef's course from ¥12,000, and no fixed start time. The owner is a sommelier and pairs sake — served at chosen temperatures — or, unusually, red wine with the sushi. The official site also describes a teyui-zushi lunch of hand-rolls you assemble, toasting the nori over charcoal (¥4,800). Booking advised.

roles: Owner-sommelier (2022 reviews; official site: ソムリエ) and a head chef (大将), with young artisans for the ¥6,000 course (official site); no names on the site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in October 2020 during the pandemic; from September 2023 the single omakase with a simultaneous start was replaced by more affordable courses at any time, including a ¥6,000 course made by a different artisan from the head chef, to pass on counter-sushi culture to younger and overseas guests; young or less experienced staff are hired as sushi artisans; fish is bought through a partner wholesaler. An October 2022 review names the chef then as Mr. Kosakai, of the Sushi Masuda line; a March 2023 review links the shop to the Sukiyabashi Jiro and Sushi Masuda lineage.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "もっとカウンター鮨を多くの方に知っていただきたい" — to make counter sushi known to more people, with some tension but no stiffness.
chef_bio.specialty: Edomae nigiri with sake or red-wine pairing; teyui-zushi lunch.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor who added the wine pairing found the chef explaining the origins of each sake and sushi in detail.
A November 2023 visitor booked the young-artisan course on TableCheck and noticed many foreign customers.
A March 2023 visitor was surprised to be served red wine with the stronger-flavoured pieces.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sushi-ovino.com): 鮨 おび乃、2020年10月オープン、2023年9月から「お任せコース1本」「一斉スタート」をやめ、好きな時間に来店可能に、若い世代や海外の方にカウンター鮨を、若手コース6,000円 (小鉢3品、鮨12貫、椀物)、大将コース 15品12,000円・20品17,000円、昼 手結寿司 TEYUI-SUSHI 4,800円 (小鉢3品、鮨ネタ10品、シャリ10〜15貫、有明海苔15枚を七輪で自分で炙る、お味噌汁)、中央市場の魚卸問屋と提携、日本酒は常時10種類以上、鮨には赤ワインを推奨、京都市中京区高宮町585 若葉ビル1階奥、富小路通り錦上ル (蛸薬師下ル) 東側、営業時間17〜21時 (最終入店19時30分)、不定休、カウンター8席、カード可。食べログ: 寿司・日本料理、8席、禁煙、子供可・お子様メニューあり、2020年10月1日オープン。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): ソムリエのオーナー、日本酒と赤ワインのペアリング、2022年は Kosakai 大将 (Sushi Masuda 系)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; the ¥6,000 course is pitched at first-timers and overseas guests; English site available.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; latest review January 2026.

kyoto_clay_pot_curry_ohmiya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: a European-style curry roux with demi-glace, breaded pork cutlet and fried toppings (official site); no gluten information is published.
kyoto_clay_pot_curry_ohmiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the curry sauce starts from a bouillon made over a day, and every curry on the menu carries meat or seafood (official site).
kyoto_clay_pot_curry_ohmiya.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (to 15:30 at weekends and holidays) and dinner 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:30); closed irregularly; may close early when ingredients run out (official site; Tabelog). Bookings taken; late arrivals may lose the table (Tabelog); booking advised at weekends (April 2026). Order by QR code: curry, spice level, rice size and toppings (September 2026). 16–17 seats: counter and small tables (Tabelog; official site); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; takeaway and delivery; menu in English, Chinese and Korean; children welcome, with a children’s curry (Tabelog; official site). On the 2nd floor of the 辨天堂ビル on the Shinkyogoku arcade south of Rokkaku, with a lift; 5 min from exit 9 of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (official site; Tabelog). Opened here 11 August 2023 after 14 years at Marutamachi (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_clay_pot_curry_ohmiya.notes: [Curry · Shinkyogoku, European curry bubbling in clay pots] A second-floor curry shop on the Shinkyogoku arcade that moved here in 2023 after 14 years at Marutamachi (once known as 近江屋清右衛門), sister to SOUP CURRY OHMIYA. The curry — a day-long bouillon, house-roasted curry powder and two days of simmering with fruit and red wine — arrives still bubbling in a clay pot. The beef rib in demi-glace (¥1,650) is the one everyone orders; Kyoto-beef, Tanba Kogen pork cutlet and keema are the local-ingredient options. Order by QR code; a September 2026 visitor saw one chef and one staff member at work, so book at weekends.

roles: Owner (unnamed; the official site says the owner chose the Kyoto beef personally); one chef and one staff member on a September 2026 visit
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a European-style curry specialist that ran for 14 years at Marutamachi before moving to Shinkyogoku; former name 欧風土鍋カレー近江屋清右衛門 (Tabelog); the sister shop is SOUP CURRY OHMIYA (in data as kyoto_soup_curry_ohmiya); for the beef curry the owner ate around Kyoto’s beef and chose certified 京の肉 from Kyoto Tanba-Kameoka. The invoice number on Tabelog is T3130001077204.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a handmade curry that takes a day for the bouillon and two days for the sauce.
chef_bio.specialty: Beef rib demi-glace curry; Kyoto-beef curry.

anecdotes.text: "The curry was bubbling in a hot pot, so much so that the ingredients were hidden from view." — April 2026.
An April 2026 diner found the place more popular with foreign tourists than locals and advised booking at weekends.
A September 2026 visitor found the toppings made the meal quite pricey.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (claypotcurryohmiya.com): 14年間丸太町で営業した後、新京極に移転した欧風カレー専門店、1日かけて作るブイヨン、ブレンド・焙煎したカレー粉、2日間フルーツや赤ワインを加えながら炊き上げる、牛バラ肉のデミグラス煮込みカレー1,650円、丹波高原豚のロースカツカレー1,550円、京の肉のビーフカレー2,200円 (京都丹波・亀岡産の黒毛和牛、オーナー自ら食べ歩いて選んだ)、自家製カレー1,000円、6時間煮込んだ煮豚と温玉のカレー1,550円、有頭エビと貝柱フライのカレー1,450円、京都ぽーくのキーマカレー1,450円、国産豚100%のハンバーグカレー1,800円、お子様向けカレー、テイクアウト・デリバリー可、姉妹店 SOUP CURRY OHMIYA、中京区桜之町438-1 辨天堂ビル2F、昼11:30〜15:00 (土日祝は15:30)、夜17:30〜21:00 (LO 20:30)、不定休、17席。食べログ: カレー・洋食、旧店名 欧風土鍋カレー近江屋清右衛門、16席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、2023年8月11日オープン、インボイス T3130001077204。口コミ (2026年3〜11月、英語): 土鍋でぐつぐつ、牛バラ肉、QR コードで注文、海外の客が多い。

kyoto_curry_kariru.gf_detail: Ask. The shop’s allergen list says its dishes may contain wheat, milk, soy, cashew, beef, pork and chicken — ask staff which (official site).
kyoto_curry_kariru.vegan_detail: Ask. A bean-and-vegetable curry (¥1,000) is on the regular menu, but the allergen list includes milk and the curry bases are not described (official site).
kyoto_curry_kariru.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 and dinner 17:00–20:30 (last order 20:00) on weekdays; lunch only on Saturday and holidays; closed Sunday and irregularly (official site; Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). A queue forms at lunch, with orders taken in line (October 2026); evenings are quieter (October 2026). Children under junior-high age not admitted, as the curry is fairly spicy (official site). Takeaway curry +¥100 for the container, ordered by phone 11:00–19:30 (official site). 21 seats; non-smoking; cards, QR and transit IC (Tabelog; official site). On Shinmachi-dori north of Marutamachi, south of the prefectural office; 4 min from exit 2 of Marutamachi Stn (official site). Opened 3 March 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_curry_kariru.notes: [Curry · Marutamachi, layered spice curry with a monthly special] A small spice-curry shop on Shinmachi-dori just north of Marutamachi, opened in 2015 and on Tabelog's Curry WEST 100 list in 2023, 2024 and 2026. The curries are thin and fragrant from layered house spice blends: chicken, butter chicken, keema, beans and vegetables — plus a monthly special (oysters in a coconut-scented sauce, ¥1,800, in October–November 2026). Add a spice egg, and the ¥50 lunch upgrade of salad and mango lassi. Expect a line at lunch, quieter evenings. No children under junior-high age. Closed Sunday; Saturday lunch only.

chef_bio.specialty: Chicken curry; butter chicken; the monthly curry.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a 15th visit found ten people in line just after noon; staff took orders in the queue and the wait was about ten minutes.
An October 2026 diner in a white top was offered a paper apron.
An October 2026 diner thought the dishes could be served warmer, "but that’s a minor detail".

kyoto_curry_biyanto.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: a smooth European-style curry, most often ordered as katsu curry with a breaded cutlet fried to order (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_curry_biyanto.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetable curry is one of the sauces (September–October 2026), but its base is not described; the others are beef and chicken.
kyoto_curry_biyanto.hours_raw: Monday to Thursday 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:50) and 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:30); Sunday and holidays 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:45); closed Friday and Saturday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog): a line forms before opening and at lunch, about 20 minutes on a Sunday in October 2026; turnover is fast (2026 reviews). Order verbally at the counter (September 2026). No photography inside (October 2026). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cash only (Tabelog). On the east side of Higashioji-dori north of Marutamachi, opposite Kyoto University Hospital; 100 m north of the Kumano-jinja-mae bus stop (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Founded in 1975 (October 2026 review).
kyoto_curry_biyanto.notes: [Curry · Kumano-jinja, a 1975 katsu-curry counter] An eight-seat curry counter on Higashioji-dori opposite Kyoto University Hospital, serving since 1975. Pick the sauce — beef from sweet to spicy, chicken or vegetable — over turmeric rice, plain or with a thin cutlet fried to order (katsu curry ¥1,200 in September 2026). Even 'medium' has a kick. A line forms at opening and at lunch, but it moves fast. Cash only; no photos inside. Closed Friday and Saturday.
